column1: # The PID Rulebook 1.6 attributes FerroSMART handles (#857, #859, #879): the
# mandatory attributes of section 2.2 and the administrative number of
# section 2.3, each with its SD-JWT VC and mdoc name, how FerroSMART handles
# it (a claim name, `identifier`, or `not retained` for the portrait, which
# Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2977 Art 3a(3) keeps a wallet-relying
# party from retaining), and the test that holds it. The unit test
# scripts/checks/conformance.sh counts a row for the README badge only when
# its test exists. Columns, tab separated: data identifier, mandatory (yes or
# no), SD-JWT VC name, mdoc name, handling, test.
